# sharosoo-cdn

> Public static hosting: Cloudflare R2 bucket `sharosoo-cdn` at `https://cdn.sharosoo.com/<key>`. Upload with the `sharosoo-cdn` CLI and embed the printed URL.

- Install: `curl -fsSL https://cdn.sharosoo.com/tools/sharosoo-cdn/install.sh | sh`
- Auth: `sharosoo-cdn login` (browser, or URL + QR code when headless) saves a Cloudflare API token; `echo $T | sharosoo-cdn login --with-token` for scripts; `SHAROSOO_CDN_TOKEN` overrides. Permissions: Account › Workers R2 Storage: Edit; Zone › Cache Purge: Purge. `sharosoo-cdn status` checks it.
- `sharosoo-cdn put <files|dirs> --prefix <topic>`: one URL per line, input order. `--key <key>` for one exact key, `--json` for `[{key,url,status,bytes}]`, `--dry-run` to preview.
- `put` verifies HTTP 200 and size. Same content → `unchanged`. Different content under an existing key → error unless `--force`, which overwrites and purges the edge.
- `sharosoo-cdn rm <key>... --yes` deletes and purges. `sharosoo-cdn ls [prefix]`, `sharosoo-cdn url <key>`.
- Old `cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/sharosoo/image@<ref>/<path>` and `raw.githubusercontent.com/sharosoo/image/<ref>/<path>` URLs map to `https://cdn.sharosoo.com/<path>`; convert with `sharosoo-cdn rewrite <files> --write`.
- Key layout: `<topic>/<file>`, kebab-case topic; screenshots under `screenshots/`.
- Limits: 300 MiB per file; everything is public; CORS allows GET/HEAD from any origin.
